articles.summary: Most advisors know how to sell the upside of a DST. The ones clients trust through a ten-year hold are the ones who also explained the risks, clearly, and before the check was written. Illiquidity. No operational control. Exit timing you don't control. Here's how to explain each DST risk to a 1031
articles.title: REITs, DSTs, and UPREITs: What’s the Difference?
